verdict.rationale: Ghostty's features page states that it supports the Kitty graphics protocol, a documented terminal graphics protocol that lets terminal applications render images inline. That directly delivers the core of the story. The evidence is limited to a brief first-party mention, with no implementation detail or hands-on confirmation. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Ghostty's protocol coverage and limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of image rendering, evidence on other graphics protocols (e.g. Sixel/iTerm2 inline images).
